tracks.purpose: Create a clearly labelled illustrative storyboard from the frozen V8S less-severe, base and more-severe kinematic envelopes.
permitted_inputs: V8S frozen mass, speed, orientation and timing envelopes
already documented geometry and official damage outlines only when their provenance is shown
explicit uncertainty bands and alternative scene branches
mandatory_labels: No predicted force, rupture, debris trajectory or structural response
Blender is not a physics-validation tool in this project
prohibited_outputs: validated damage mask or debris field

tracks.purpose: Reopen physical impact qualification only after new primary evidence closes every controlling rupture, material, joint, benchmark and convergence gap.

required_triggers.requirement: Traceable impact-zone plate, weld, bolt, window and floor-attachment definitions with relevant rate and failure data.
Traceable CF6-80A2 core, cowling and attachment material/failure definitions at relevant rates.
A physical fracture-energy or internal-length bound identified independently of facade impulse.
A lawful deck or deterministic reconstruction with measured outputs, deformable-projectile rupture and an objective failure treatment.
A common measured observable on three comparable meshes with medium-to-fine eroding impulse difference no greater than 10 percent and a bounded fracture-length sensitivity no greater than 10 percent.

tracks.source_policy: Do not resume broad web searching. Evaluate only a newly identified primary source or user-supplied local evidence against the unchanged gates.
tracks.foia_policy: Last resort only; no request is sent and no external contact is made in V9M.

next_iteration.objective: Prepare a visualization-only 3D storyboard specification from the frozen V8S kinematic envelopes, with three uncertainty branches, explicit provenance for every geometric input and permanent non-physical-validation overlays. Do not execute Blender or any solver in V9N; keep the physical track dormant unless genuinely new primary evidence is supplied.
